name: Park Hyatt Jeddah Marina Club & Spa
insider_take: Where the Red Sea meets refined luxury — Park Hyatt Jeddah Marina Club & Spa is Saudi Arabia's crown jewel of waterfront sophistication, blending Arabian heritage with world-class elegance along one of the kingdom's most breathtaking coastlines.
whats_special: Perched directly on the Jeddah Marina , guests enjoy stunning Red Sea views and direct access to one of the city's most vibrant waterfront destinations Home to an award-winning spa and private beach club , offering an exclusive retreat within Saudi Arabia's most cosmopolitan city Just minutes from the UNESCO-listed Al-Balad district , Jeddah's historic old city famous for its coral-built towers and ornate wooden mashrabiya windows Booked through Hyatt Privé , guests enjoy exclusive perks including daily breakfast, room upgrades, and resort credits unavailable through standard booking channels
pro_tip: Request a Red Sea-facing room for front-row views of Jeddah's iconic waterfront and — on clear nights — a spectacular backdrop of the King Fahd Fountain, the world's tallest fountain, illuminated against the Arabian sky.
dont_miss: The Marina Promenade — stroll the vibrant waterfront lined with upscale dining and boutiques right at the hotel's doorstep Al-Balad Old Town — a UNESCO World Heritage Site just a short drive away, offering centuries of rich Hijazi culture and architecture Floating Mosque (Al-Rahma Mosque) — one of the most photographed landmarks in Saudi Arabia, appearing to float on the Red Sea at high tide
pros: Stunning Red Sea waterfront location with marina views
Prime location in Jeddah's modern marina district
cons: This property is not available for online booking.
